description.en: Turn DeepSeek Harness into a QQ bot channel over OneBot v11. Receives private and group messages including images through a reverse WebSocket or HTTP connection, answers with the model currently selected in Harness (no API key needed) or an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint, and ships a built-in DSH panel for QR login, one-click NapCat installation, status, logs, conversation history and long-term per-user memory.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 QQ 机器人通道：基于 OneBot v11，通过反向 WebSocket / HTTP 接收私聊与群消息（含图片），默认直接调用 Harness 当前选中的模型回答（免密钥），也可切换 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点；内置 DSH 面板提供扫码登录、NapCat 一键安装与接入、状态、日志、会话上下文与按用户隔离的长期记忆。
